title: Controlled request quarantine and reconstructive telemetry for customer-escalated Hosted 5xx/timeouts
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Summary: During the recent customer-visible 5xx/timeouts wave, repeat client retries amplified backend pressure and obscured root cause signals. This ticket implements an edge-level 'request quarantine' mechanism combined with reconstructive telemetry capture so we can: 1) rapidly stop harmful retry storms from reaching inference workers; 2) preserve enough request context to reproduce failures offline; 3) provide an observable bridge (dashboards + traces) so SRE/SEs can validate customer fixes without adding latency to healthy traffic.

Scope & goals:
- Implement quarantine at the edge-proxy: when a request pattern matches retry-storm heuristics (high duplicate id rate, bursty replays within a 30s window, serialized client tokens), subsequent duplicates are short-circuited to a lightweight quarantined responder that returns 503 with Retry-After and structured telemetry.
- Capture reconstructive telemetry: store a scrubbed snapshot (headers, approx payload size, fingerprint, model-config) in a short-lived store (TTL 1h) for offline rehydration in staging; do NOT persist raw prompts.
- Provide a 'replay token' surface in the telemetry payload so oncall can request deterministic replay in a sandbox environment.
- Add dashboards and alerts: per-tenant duplicate-rate, quarantine rate, and KV-prefetch thrash signals.
- Hotfix plan: ship edge-proxy patch + canary (10% traffic) within 24h of approval; automatic rollback on increased latency or error regressions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Quarantine reduces duplicate request volume to inference workers by >= 80% during synthetic retry storms in canary environment.
- Telemetry snapshots are linkable from the incident console and include enough metadata for reproducible failure cases without exposing customer prompt text.
- No customer-visible increase in median P95 latency for non-quarantined requests after canary.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not change model routing fallback behavior (handled in separate follow-up).
- This ticket does not implement long-term storage of customer payloads or new KMS flows.

Links and artifacts:
- Design doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRN/Request+Quarantine+Design
- Implementation PR (edge-proxy): https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/2187
- Rehydration harness (staging): https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay-harness/pull/42
- Incident dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/incident/retry-storms
- Customer comms template: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Incidents/CustomerComms/QuarantineTemplate
comments: 2026-03-01 | Ava Patel: Created ticket after oncall debrief. Initial design sketch attached to Confluence. Noted privacy constraint: do not persist raw prompt text; use hashed fingerprints and size buckets.

2026-03-03 | Liam Chen: Spike complete - implemented prototype quarantine logic in local edge-proxy. Observed 85% reduction in worker-facing duplicates on synthetic replay. Tested with stress harness - KV-prefetch thrash surfaced as new risk.

2026-03-05 | SRE (Jordan Miller): Reviewed prototype; requested fallback to return structured 503 with Retry-After and a short 'replay token' header to aid diagnostics. Also asked for per-tenant kill-switch and metric tagging.
2026-03-07 | Security (Priya Rao): Reviewed telemetry plan. Approved scrubbed metadata approach. Asked to add KMS note to avoid storing any plaintext customer prompts; confirmed TTL 1h is acceptable.
2026-03-09 | Liam Chen: PR #2187 opened for edge-proxy quarantine + telemetry; initial unit tests and integration tests added (link above). Canary rollout plan drafted in PR description.

2026-03-11 | PM (Diego Marquez): Approved prioritized rollout. Suggested a customer-facing FAQ blurb to include in support escalations. Added to project roadmap for follow-up observability improvements.

2026-03-12 | Oncall (Maya Singh): Deployed canary to eu-west-1 (10%). Observations: quarantine reduced duplicate traffic; a small increase in edge CPU (2.1% median) but within SLO. Noted two tenants with high quarantined-rate; SE outreach scheduled.
2026-03-14 | QA (Ellen Park): Ran regression suite. No P95 latency regressions on unaffected routes. Found edge-proxy unit test flake (fixed in PR 2193).

2026-03-15 | Liam Chen: Preparing canary expansion to 40% after manual verification and SE outreach to affected customers. Next steps: full rollout gating, postmortem write-up, and follow-up ticket for automated tenant-unquarantine workflow.
follow_up_actions: Create ENG ticket to implement automated tenant-unquarantine with SE override and audit logging (post-rollout)
Add KV-prefetch stabilization: limit prefetch concurrency per-tenant to reduce eviction thrash (follow-up runtime change)
Add structured replay execution in sandbox with RBAC so SEs can run customer-safe replays internally
Instrument SDK guidance: document idempotency key best-practices and publish to support KB
